DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Angiitis of the Central Nervous System.

The combination of subacute cognitive decline (6 months), behavioral changes (paranoia), and acute focal motor deficits (1-week right leg weakness) with gait instability is highly concerning for inflammatory vasculitis of the brain. Before we proceed with imaging, do you or your daughter have any family history of autoimmune diseases or recent infections?
